title: Soccer Rugs: Sizes, Prices and What to Check First
meta_description: Soccer rugs in 8 sizes from $30.89 to $136.90. Measure your floor, compare price per square foot, and check each design's features.
body_html:
A Chillgen soccer rug starts at $30.89 for 24"x24" and goes up to $136.90 for 60"x96". The right one depends on the floor space you can clear, the shape of that space, and which features the design lists.

Contents

  1. What size soccer area rug fits your room?
  2. Is a bigger soccer rug better value?
  3. Which features come on every soccer rug, and which depend on the design?
  4. Soccer rug designs: trophies, flags, landmarks, or a soccer field rug?
  5. Worked example: sizing a boys soccer rug for a small bedroom

What size soccer area rug fits your room?

Start with the floor, not the design. There are 19 soccer rugs in the range, and each one comes in a set list of sizes, so your measurement makes most of the choice for you.

The listings use two size lists. One has equal-sided rugs: 24"x24", 36"x36", 48"x48", 60"x60" and 72"x72". The other has rectangles: 36"x60", 48"x72" and 60"x96". A design won't necessarily offer both lists. Several of the featured designs also have "round-rug" in their web address. So look at the photos and the size picker on the page of the design you want. A rug listed as 48"x48" needs a 4 ft by 4 ft space on the floor whether it's round or square, so the table below works for both shapes.

To read the table, divide each measurement in inches by 12 to get feet. That's how we worked out the floor space and footprint columns. The prices are the lowest listed for each size.

Size (inches)Floor space (feet)Footprint (sq ft)Starting pricePrice per sq ft of footprint*Size listSuits

What to check

  • Measure the clear floor you want covered, in feet, with the furniture in place.
  • Mark that shape on the floor with tape or newspaper before you order.
  • Check that the door still opens over the area you marked.
  • Open the size picker on your chosen design and confirm your size is there.

Is a bigger soccer rug better value?

Per square foot, yes. In total, no. At $30.89 the 24"x24" rug has the lowest price in the range, but it has the highest price per square foot in the table. The 60"x96" rug has the lowest rate per square foot, less than half of what the smallest size costs, though you pay $136.90 in total.

Prices don't rise evenly from one size to the next. Of all the steps between neighbouring equal-sided sizes, 36"x36" ($54.89) to 48"x48" ($64.89) is the smallest price jump. It also takes the footprint from 9 to 16 sq ft. If your floor can take 48"x48", that's the cheapest point in the range to size up.

By footprint, the rectangles cost a little more per square foot than equal-sided sizes of similar footprint. Compare 48"x72" with 60"x60" in the table. So pick between them by the shape of your floor rather than by price. A long gap beside a bed suits a rectangle. An open patch in the middle of a room suits an equal-sided rug.

To use this at home, take the two closest sizes from the table and compare both the total price and the floor you get for it. Then ask whether the extra area is floor someone will actually play on.

What to check

  • The prices here are the lowest listed for each size. Check the price of your chosen design on its product page.
  • Does the size that's cheaper per square foot still fit the floor you marked out?
  • Will the extra area cover floor that's in use, or floor under furniture?

Which features come on every soccer rug, and which depend on the design?

Only one feature is listed on every product page. The others appear on some designs and not on others, so read the listing for the rug you want.

How many of the 19 product pages list each feature:

  • Non-slip backing, 19 of 19: "Equipped with a practical non-slip backing for enhanced safety."
  • Personalization, 17 of 19: "Supports personalization and custom design features."
  • Low pile, 11 of 19: "Low pile height provides a comfortable feel underfoot."
  • Reinforced serged edges, 10 of 19: "Designed for durability with reinforced serged edges."
  • Memory foam, 6 of 19: "Soft memory foam material offers a comfortable underfoot feel."

Decide on two of these before you choose a design. The first is personalization. If you want a name or number on the rug, you're choosing from 17 designs, not 19. The second is cushioning. If you want something soft to sit or lie on, only 6 product pages mention memory foam. If you like two designs equally, compare low pile and serged edges next.

These counts tell you how common each feature is, not which design has it. Only the product page tells you that.

What to check

  • Open the product page and look for the feature sentences quoted above.
  • If you want a name added, confirm that personalization is offered before you choose a size.
  • If cushioning matters, look for the memory foam line.
  • Don't assume one design has a feature because another design does.

Soccer rug designs: trophies, flags, landmarks, or a soccer field rug?

Once you know the size and features, the design comes down to taste. The six designs below all start at $30.89, which is the 24"x24" price.

If the room's theme is a big tournament, start with the trophy designs. The Soccer Tournament Trophy Rug puts the trophy at the centre. The Soccer Stadium Trophy Rug and the Soccer Host Flags Trophy Rug add a stadium or host-country flags around it.

For a child who follows teams from many countries, a flag design suits better. The World Flags Animal Soccer Rug pairs flags with animal characters, which may suit a younger child's room.

If you'd rather show places than flags, the Soccer Host Landmarks Rug features host-city landmarks. Of the six, the USA Eagle Soccer Championship Rug is the national-pride choice.

Looking for a soccer field rug laid out like a full pitch, or a soccer ball rug with the ball as the main motif? The six featured designs are built around trophies, flags, landmarks and a stadium, so look through the rest of the range: see all 19 soccer rug designs side by side.

What to check

  • Does the design you like come in the size you measured?
  • If you want a name added, does it list personalization?
  • Which features does its product page list? Use the counts in the section above.
  • How will the colours look next to the bedding or walls already in the room?

Worked example: sizing a boys soccer rug for a small bedroom

This example and its measurements are made up. It shows the method, not a real customer.

The room. Say a bedroom is 10 ft by 9 ft. A single bed runs along one wall and a desk sits against another. With both in place, the clear floor between them is about 5 ft by 6 ft. The parent wants space to sit and play, and the child wants his name on the rug.

Step 1: Narrow the sizes. From the table, three sizes fit inside 5 ft by 6 ft: 48"x48" (4 x 4 ft), 60"x60" (5 x 5 ft) and 48"x72" (4 x 6 ft). The 72"x72" rug (6 x 6 ft) is too wide, and the 60"x96" rug (5 x 8 ft) is too long.

Step 2: Compare the cost. At starting prices, the 48"x48" rug is $64.89 for 16 sq ft. The 60"x60" rug is $94.89 for 25 sq ft, and the 48"x72" rug is $101.90 for 24 sq ft. The 60"x60" has a slightly bigger footprint than the rectangle and costs less.

Step 3: Tape it out. Taped on the floor, the 60"x60" fills the gap but runs right up to the bed frame. The 48"x72" leaves a strip of floor along the bed and still reaches the desk.

Step 4: Decide on shape. The parent prefers the 48"x72". It costs more, but it matches the shape of the room and keeps the bed edge clear. The 60"x60" stays as the second choice, because Step 3 showed it also fits.

Step 5: Check the design. The child wants the Soccer Tournament Trophy Rug with his name on it. On that product page, the parent checks two things: that personalization is listed, and which size list the picker shows. If 48"x72" is offered, that's the order. If the picker only shows equal-sided sizes, the parent orders the 60"x60" instead.

What to check

  • Measure the clear floor, not the room.
  • Narrow down to the sizes that fit, then compare price and footprint.
  • Tape out the sizes on your shortlist before you choose.
  • Confirm size and personalization on the product page, and know your second-choice size before you open it.

Have your measurements ready? Compare all 19 soccer rugs in your size.
